content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

When it comes to selling digital products, platforms like Gumroad and PayPal offer user-friendly interfaces but impose steep fees and restrictions. For example, Gumroad takes a significant 10% per transaction, which rapidly eats into creators' profits. In contrast, solutions powered by COREMERCH, like NOWPayments, charge only 0.5%, allowing creators to retain more of their earnings. This architectural choice empowers creators, giving them complete ownership of their sales processes without depending on external platforms.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Many creators in restricted countries face significant hurdles when trying to monetize their work through mainstream platforms. These services often disallow users from these regions, leaving them without viable options. COREMERCH's infrastructure is built with these creators in mind, providing a sovereign commerce stack that operates independently of traditional payment processors. This ensures that anyone, regardless of their location, can sell digital products seamlessly and efficiently, circumventing the barriers erected by major platforms.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

The cost of doing business online can be prohibitive when relying on traditional payment processors. Gumroad's 10% fee on every sale adds up quickly; at 100 sales of a $97 product, creators lose $921 in fees. Alternatively, NOWPayments charges just 0.5% with no additional fees for creators who use the recommended low-cost networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON. This results in faster payment processing and significantly lower costs, allowing creators to reinvest their profits into their businesses.
NOWPayments charges just 0.5%, not 10% like Gumroad.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Ownership is a critical consideration for digital creators. Platforms like Gumroad may lock you into their ecosystem, meaning you have limited control over your customer data and product delivery. COREMERCH solutions offer complete ownership after deployment, with automated delivery mechanisms through Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. This not only provides a seamless experience for customers but also ensures that creators maintain control over their intellectual property and sales data.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

Selecting the right architecture depends on your specific needs as a digital creator. If you are looking for a rapid deployment solution and plan to sell a limited number of products, the Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal. For those needing more robust capabilities, the Edge Commerce Stack offers enhanced features, including a fully tested setup and advanced analytics. Assess your product range and business model to determine which stack aligns best with your goals.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, consider using a sovereign commerce stack from COREMERCH. This solution allows you to accept crypto payments directly, ensuring you maintain full control over your sales and customer data without the fees associated with traditional platforms. It’s a straightforward way to monetize your digital products seamlessly.
Complete ownership means no platform lock-in or dependency.

This kit provides all the blueprints and templates needed to build and deploy your sovereign digital commerce stack immediately. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get started today.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
